title: Mythic: Garothi Worldbreaker
description: Defeat the Garothi Worldbreaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Hounds of Sargeras
description: Defeat the Hounds of Sargeras in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Antoran High Command
description: Defeat the Antoran High Command in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Portal Keeper Hasabel
description: Defeat Portal Keeper Hasabel in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Eonar
description: Successfully defend Eonar in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Imonar the Soulhunter
description: Defeat Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Kin'garoth
description: Defeat Kin'garoth in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Varimathras
description: Defeat Varimathras in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: The Coven of Shivarra
description: Defeat The Coven of Shivarra in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Aggramar
description: Defeat Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Mythic: Argus the Unmaker
description: Defeat Argus the Unmaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Mythic difficulty.

title: Welcome the Void
description: Bring Urjad from the void realm using Void Tear, then defeat him and Zuraal the Ascended in Seat of the Triumvirate on Mythic Difficulty.

title: Let it All Out
description: Have Darkfang destroy 4 Sealed Void Caches using Shadow Pounce, then defeat Saprish in Seat of the Triumvirate on Mythic Difficulty.

title: Heroic: Seat of the Triumvirate
description: Defeat L'ura in Seat of the Triumvirate on Heroic difficulty or higher.

title: Mythic: Seat of the Triumvirate
description: Defeat L'ura in Seat of the Triumvirate on Mythic difficulty.

title: Darker Side
description: Defeat L'ura in Seat of the Triumvirate with all party members affected by Crushing Darkness on Mythic Difficulty.

title: Invasion Obliteration
description: Defeat each of the following Legion Generals by completing each of the Greater Invasion Point scenarios.

title: Envision Invasion Eradication
description: Slay each of the demonic commanders that can control the Invasion Points.

title: The World Revolves Around Me
description: Defeat Kin'garoth with 9 Diabolic Bombs active in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher.

title: Remember the Titans
description: Defeat the Coven of Shivarra in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher while at least one of each Torment survives.

title: Hounds Good To Me
description: Defeat the Felhounds of Sargeras in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher with both Felhounds afflicted with 5 stacks of Fel Imbuement.

title: You Are Now Prepared!
description: Complete the Argus campaign.

title: Spheres of Influence
description: Collect the 5 Orbs of Life placed around Eonar's sanctuary in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher.

title: Explore Argus
description: Explore Argus, revealing the covered areas of the world map on Krokuun, Mac'Aree, and the Antoran Wastes.

title: Crucible's Promise
description: Fully unlock the power of the Netherlight Crucible on one of your artifact weapons.

title: Now You're Cooking with Netherlight
description: Unlock the Netherlight Crucible.

title: Locked and Loaded
description: Unlock all of the powers for the Vindicaar Matrix Core.

title: Shoot First, Loot Later
description: Discover the hidden treasures of Argus.

title: Protector of the Argussian Reach
description: Earn Exalted status with the Argussian Reach.

title: Adventurer of Argus
description: Complete 25 of the following special encounters on Argus.

title: Commander of Argus
description: Complete the following special encounters on Argus.

title: Officer of the Light
description: Earn Exalted status with the Army of the Light.

title: Paragon of Argus
description: Complete the Argus achievements listed below.

title: Infused and Abused
description: Kill 10 enemies while Fel Infused from a single lightning strike on Argus.

title: We Came Here For Two Reasons
description: Slay 100 non-trivial demons in Krokuun, Mac'Aree, and the Antoran Wastes.

title: To Kill Demons...
description: Slay 500 non-trivial demons in Krokuun, Mac'Aree, and the Antoran Wastes.

title: ...And Chew Mana Buns
description: Slay 2000 non-trivial demons in Krokuun, Mac'Aree, and the Antoran Wastes.

title: And We're All Out of Mana Buns
description: Slay 5000 non-trivial demons in Krokuun, Mac'Aree, and the Antoran Wastes.

title: This is the War Room!
description: Defeat the Antoran High Command in Antorus, the Burning Throne while placing three or fewer Felshield Emitters.

title: Stardust Crusaders
description: Collect 20 Motes of Titanic Power within 5 seconds and then defeat Argus the Unmaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher.

title: Highmountain Tribe
description: Earn Exalted status with the Highmountain Tribe.

title: The Total Package
description: Find the Postmaster in Dalaran and lend him your aid.

title: Post Haste
description: Sort 30 letters within 60 seconds in the Postmaster's Office.

title: Priority Mail
description: Sort 30 partially addressed letters within 60 seconds in the Postmaster's Office.
